reference.derivation: Printed in CRE99 Example 3, rounded to the printed digit; checked against the text, tables and equation images on 2026-10-09. CRE99.20 keeps intermediate results unrounded and rounds the displayed results and the final EAD. The source prints USD thousands; the value here is that figure times 1,000. Trade 1 (WTI) has a residual maturity of 9 months as printed (CRE99.59); the fixture enters 270 days with DaysPerYear 360, which gives exactly 0.75 years. Ported from prototype TestCatalogue T07.
